body: Enhance my todo app, I want to create recurring tasks for my todo app. Everything should work on client side.

comments.body:
Picking this up 👀

**Ask:** recurring tasks for the todo app, entirely client-side.

**Built in PR #10:** https://github.com/karachiwaladev/contour-jonas-oct-2026-eng-muhammad-anas/pull/10
- Tasks can repeat daily, weekly or monthly
- Ticking one done keeps it in Completed and creates the next copy
- Monthly tasks keep their day of the month (Jan 31 → Feb 28 → Mar 31)
- Unticking and re-ticking never creates a duplicate
- Everything is stored in IndexedDB

Tested in headless Microsoft Edge with 16/16 checks passing, and the earlier #5 checks still pass 18/18. A Claude Security scan of the change found nothing. The checklist and screenshots are in the PR. This ticket closes automatically when the PR is merged.
